sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:76

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:76:1
items.html: The first discernment, how the worlds were at the time Adam HaRishon was created, etc. And one should know that this first discernment is regarded as the discernment of the permanence of the Mochin of BYA, except that they descended from their place because of the sin of the Tree of Knowledge.
